recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. If FM wants the Claim.insurer definition modernized as well, handle that as a separate editorial or work-group decision rather than bundling it into this STU3 short-description reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-17922 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification FM change request raised against STU3 for FHIR-core Claim. It requested changing Claim.insurer's short description from "Target" to the approved wording "Party to adjudicate the request".
initial_application: A historical batch commit, afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a, mentioned FHIR-17922, but inspecting the resulting Claim spreadsheet showed Claim.insurer still had short text "Target" and definition "The Insurer who is target of the request." The current generated StructureDefinition source retained that stale short description.
additional_context: Claim is active current build source through source/fhir.ini. A later reconciled FHIR-19457 commit made Claim.insurer mandatory but left the short and definition wording unchanged, so it does not supersede or complete the FHIR-17922 wording request. Zulip and Confluence searches found no discussion or conflicting work-group record.
reconciliation: Changed source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml so Claim.insurer.short is "Party to adjudicate the request". The longer definition was left unchanged because FHIR-17922 specifically approved a short-description change and no evidence supported a broader definition rewrite.
source_changes: source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml: changed Claim.insurer.short from "Target" to "Party to adjudicate the request".

related_jiras.note: Later reconciled same-element Claim.insurer cardinality issue made insurer mandatory but did not address or supersede the short-description wording.
